name: Cyclops
bio: Xavier's first student and the X-Men's longest-serving field leader. Emotionally guarded, defined by duty, and the centre of the franchise's most famous love triangle. His arc from loyal son to revolutionary (Schism, Avengers vs. X-Men) is one of the longest character arcs in comics.

continuity.name: Earth-616
continuity.description: The main Marvel Comics continuity, running continuously since Fantastic Four #1 (1961).

era.name: Silver Age (Lee/Kirby/Thomas)
era.description: X-Men #1 (1963) through the original run's cancellation at #66. The first five students and the founding Xavier/Magneto conflict.

relationships.label: First love, marriage, Phoenix, death
relationships.summary: The franchise's central romance. A shy mutual crush in 1963 became the marriage in X-Men #30 (1994), was broken by Jean's death as Dark Phoenix, by her resurrection, by Scott's psychic affair with Emma Frost, and by Jean's second death. Her Krakoan return left them cordial co-workers rather than a couple.

events.note: Scott's unspoken feelings for Jean are established in the first issue.
Dark Phoenix Saga ends with Jean's suicide on the Moon to stop herself.
Scott and Jean marry.
Jean discovers Scott's psychic affair with Emma.
Jean is killed by Xorn/Magneto; she tells Scott to live.

continuity.name: Earth-616
continuity.description: The main Marvel Comics continuity, running continuously since Fantastic Four #1 (1961).

era.name: Claremont Era
era.description: Giant-Size X-Men #1 (1975) through Chris Claremont's departure after X-Men #3 (1991). The all-new team, Phoenix, Days of Future Past, the Brood, Inferno.

relationships.label: Rivals for Jean, then for the X-Men
relationships.summary: Started as a love-triangle rivalry over Jean Grey and became a philosophical one: Logan, the soldier, came to believe children should be kept out of the war; Scott, the field leader, came to believe there was no one else to fight it. The 2011 Schism split the X-Men between them.

events.note: Logan joins; friction with Cyclops's leadership is immediate.
Wolverine's famous 'Now it's my turn' in the Hellfire Club, while Scott is captured.
The two fight on Utopia over whether to send students into battle; Wolverine leaves to reopen the school.
Logan sides with the Avengers against a Phoenix-possessed Cyclops.

continuity.name: Earth-616
continuity.description: The main Marvel Comics continuity, running continuously since Fantastic Four #1 (1961).

era.name: Morrison / Whedon Era
era.description: New X-Men (2001–2004) and Astonishing X-Men (2004–2008). Emma Frost joins, Jean dies, the school becomes a school.

relationships.label: Psychic affair to power couple
relationships.summary: Began as telepathic 'therapy' during Scott's marriage, became an affair, and after Jean's death became the X-Men's leadership couple through the Utopia era. Ended when Phoenix-possessed Scott turned on Emma; they have remained allies with history since.

events.note: Emma offers Scott telepathic counselling; it turns intimate.
Jean, from the future, pushes Scott toward Emma; they kiss on Jean's grave and reopen the school.
Headmaster and headmistress; the relationship becomes the team's centre.
Scott takes Emma's share of the Phoenix by force.

relationships.label: Brothers, perpetually compared
relationships.summary: Separated as children after a plane crash, reunited as adults. Alex has spent most of his career defining himself against Scott—leading X-Factor and the Avengers Unity Squad as the brother who is not Cyclops—and the two have fought on opposite sides more than once.

events.note: Alex is introduced and revealed as Scott's brother.
Alex leads the Unity Squad while Scott is imprisoned.

continuity.name: Earth-1610 (Ultimate)
continuity.description: The original Ultimate Marvel universe (2000–2015), a modern-day reboot with younger characters.

era.name: Morrison / Whedon Era
era.description: New X-Men (2001–2004) and Astonishing X-Men (2004–2008). Emma Frost joins, Jean dies, the school becomes a school.

relationships.label: Teenage version
relationships.summary: In the Ultimate universe they are teenagers, the romance is more volatile, and Jean briefly chooses Wolverine. Included as a continuity contrast to the 616 marriage.

events.note: Scott and Jean established as a couple at Xavier's.
Jean leaves Scott for Logan, briefly.

continuity.description: The main Marvel Comics continuity, running continuously since Fantastic Four #1 (1961).

era.name: Silver Age (Lee/Kirby/Thomas)
era.description: X-Men #1 (1963) through the original run's cancellation at #66. The first five students and the founding Xavier/Magneto conflict.

relationships.label: Favourite son to patricide
relationships.summary: Xavier's first and most loyal student. The relationship curdled as Scott learned how much Xavier had hidden (Deadly Genesis, 2006), and ended when a Phoenix-possessed Scott killed Xavier. Krakoa, with Xavier resurrected, treated it as a wound neither wanted to discuss.

events.note: Scott is Xavier's field leader from the first mission.
Scott learns Xavier erased his memory of a lost team and expels him from the mansion.
Dark Phoenix Cyclops kills Xavier.
